units.source_text: 傍晚我和妻子在饭店汇合，一起去看看当天寻找到的房子。

en.t: That evening my wife and I met at the inn and went together to look at the house I had found that day.

units.source_text: 初来乍到此地的妻子，对大森靠近山的没有方向的夜道，哪能辨认清楚呢。

en.t: My wife, having only just arrived there, could hardly find her way along the dark, directionless roads on the mountain side of Omori.

units.source_text: 她看到白走了许多冤枉路而焦急的我，差点哭了出来。

en.t: Seeing me anxious after walking so many pointless detours, she nearly burst into tears.
